test_case.name: CrashLoopBackOff (Missing Secret / Startup Configuration Failure)
test_case.scenario_description: The authentication service pod 'auth-token-service-84d9b6c7f-z9p3x' (container 'auth-server', namespace 'identity') fails on startup because the required RSA private key file '/etc/secrets/jwt/private.pem' is missing from its mounted Secret volume. The process exits with code 1 on every boot attempt, causing kubelet to place the pod into CrashLoopBackOff after 6 rapid restarts.
test_case.injected_fault: Missing '/etc/secrets/jwt/private.pem' key in mounted Kubernetes Secret causes immediate startup exit (code 1) and exponential CrashLoopBackOff.
test_case.ground_truth_rca: Container 'auth-server' in pod 'auth-token-service-84d9b6c7f-z9p3x' is stuck in CrashLoopBackOff (restartCount=6, exit code 1) because it cannot load the required JWT signing key at '/etc/secrets/jwt/private.pem' during initialization.
